history_restore_surface_label: Example history-restore and hidden-return posture for an official voter-information route
delivery_role_note: Bounded history-restore review surface for an official voter-information route that may remain open across Back/Forward, app switching, tab hiding, session restore, or duplicate tabs.
return_freshness_policy_note: When the page becomes visible again or returns from history/restore, the route revalidates or clearly warns if the controlling answer may no longer be current.
history_navigation_alignment_note: Back/Forward history entries are reviewed so they restore meaningful step/result context rather than a contradictory shell.
hidden_tab_restore_policy_note: Returning from a hidden tab, app switch, or restored session does not silently present uncertain stale answer content as current official state.
parallel_tab_divergence_policy_note: Duplicate or parallel tabs are treated as either read-only mirrors, warned divergence states, or unsupported with a safe re-entry path.
last_checked_cue_note: Where currentness matters, the route provides a visible last-checked, refresh, or re-entry cue.
safe_reentry_or_help_note: If current state cannot safely be trusted on return, the voter is sent to a first-party re-entry/help route rather than left on ambiguous preserved content.
